title: Beekeeping Word Search
subtitle: Large Print: 60 Easy-to-Read Puzzles for Beekeepers, Adults & Seniors
author: Hollow Pine Puzzles
description:
A sweet break from the hive.

Hang up your veil and enjoy 60 large print word search puzzles made for people who love bees. Every puzzle is built around the world of the hive, from queens, drones and the waggle dance to smokers, supers, swarms and the honey harvest.

Inside you'll find:

  • 60 themed puzzles: hive parts, bee biology, types of honey, flowers bees love, the beekeeping year and more
  • Large, bold letters on big 8.5 x 11 inch pages that are easy on the eyes
  • Words run forward and diagonally only, never backwards
  • One puzzle per page, with every answer at the back

A thoughtful gift for beekeepers, bee club friends, gardeners and nature lovers, from first-year hobbyists to seasoned apiarists.
